title: EscaFlow
tagline: AI escalator safety, deployed in Baku Metro.
description: An AI escalator-safety platform that detects crowd density, unsafe movement and falls from live camera feeds, with analyst and dispatcher dashboards for human-in-the-loop alerts.
longDescription: EscaFlow watches live escalator camera feeds and flags risks in real time – crowd density, unsafe movement, falls – using YOLO and OpenCV models in Python. Alerts flow into analyst and dispatcher dashboards (Laravel API, Next.js front-end) where a human confirms and acts on them. I built the full system; it won 1st place at the Baku Metro Hackathon 2026 with team KhatAI and is now deployed in Baku Metro. The production system runs inside the metro network, so there is no public demo; the hackathon prototype is open source.

title: ODLAR
tagline: One fire record for the Land of Fire.
description: Harmonizes NASA's MODIS and VIIRS satellite fire archives into one 25-year record, with district fire calendars and 7-day and 13-week fire-risk forecasts. 1st place, NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 Baku.
longDescription: ODLAR merges NASA's two active-fire archives – MODIS (1 km, since 2000) and VIIRS (375 m, since 2012), which aren't comparable as they stand – into one consistent 25-year record. On that record it builds a burning-activity calendar for every district and forecasts fire risk with LightGBM, for the next 7 days and as a 13-week outlook; harmonization lifts forecast skill over climatology (Brier skill score from −0.02 to +0.13). It covers 193 countries and is updated daily from NASA FIRMS, with Azerbaijan as the home pilot. Built with team NASAZ: a Python data pipeline, FastAPI analytics, a Laravel gateway with PostGIS and alerts, and a Next.js + MapLibre map app, with 300+ automated tests. It won 1st place at NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 in Baku, is a Global Nominee, and has drawn interest from the Global Fire Monitoring Center (GFMC, Germany) and SOCAR.

title: Fermachi
tagline: Azerbaijan's marketplace for farm machinery, services & produce.
description: A trilingual agricultural marketplace where anyone can rent out farm machinery, hire field services, and buy or sell produce from a single account – 200 users within 5 months of launch.
longDescription: Fermachi lets Azerbaijani farmers and providers list and book agricultural machinery, field services, and goods through one unified account – with a server-enforced booking flow, escrow-style payments and platform commission, bidirectional reviews, real-time chat and notifications, and an AI assistant. It's built as a three-part polyrepo: a Laravel 11 REST + WebSocket API on PostgreSQL, a Next.js 16 web app, and a Flutter mobile app for iOS and Android. It also runs live auctions, and ships FermachiAI – an AI agronomist that advises on planting, crop treatment and prices. It reached 200 users within five months of launch. I'm co-founder, CTO and sole developer.

title: Jabish
tagline: AI-assisted teaching, and a way to find the right tutor.
description: An EdTech platform where teachers create exams, homework and lessons with AI, and students find tutors by subject, level and city – nearly 80 users in its first three months.
longDescription: Jabish is an EdTech platform I co-founded and build as CTO and sole developer. Teachers upload their material – photos or PDFs – and AI drafts editable exams, homework and lessons with answer keys, exported as PDF. Teachers also get public profiles, a lesson calendar and student rosters; students find tutors by subject, level and city; schools post jobs teachers can apply to. Built and deployed end to end – Laravel API on PostgreSQL, Next.js front-ends, shipped with Docker, Nginx and CI/CD – it reached nearly 80 users in under three months.

title: Vevy Product AI
tagline: AI-powered Shopify app for product descriptions.
description: AI-powered Shopify app for automated product-description generation.
longDescription: A Shopify app that generates product descriptions with AI. Built full-stack in Laravel: OAuth against the Shopify Admin API, billing, store data sync, and the generation pipeline that turns sparse product fields into copy a merchant will actually keep. Live on the Shopify App Store.

title: Shopify Apps: QX, SLOT, RecurrinGO!
tagline: Discounts, bookings and subscriptions on the Shopify App Store.
description: Features and fixes for three live Shopify App Store apps: QX (quantity discounts), SLOT (appointment and rental booking) and RecurrinGO! (subscriptions).
longDescription: Alongside building vevy, I developed features and fixes for three production Shopify apps that are live on the Shopify App Store: QX for quantity discounts, SLOT for appointment and rental booking, and RecurrinGO! for subscriptions. Work spanned Laravel back-ends, Shopify Admin API integration and MySQL data models.

title: YouCanSupport
tagline: A help-center platform businesses publish on their own domain.
description: A platform that lets businesses create and organize help-center articles, fully customize their knowledge base, and publish it on their own domain.
longDescription: YouCanSupport is a full knowledge-base product: a Laravel application where teams write and organize help-center articles, customize branding, and serve the result on their own domain, fronted by a fast Astro marketing site. I worked across the whole thing – the data model and API in Laravel/MySQL, and the content-first landing page in Astro.

title: Baji
tagline: A health guide for girls and women.
description: A trilingual health guide for girls and women, with consultants and a delivery shop, on a freemium model.
longDescription: Baji is a university venture project, still in development: a health guide for girls and women with consultants and a delivered shop, in Azerbaijani, Russian and English. It runs on a freemium model (Free, Plus, Pro) whose plan rules are enforced in a Laravel API; the Next.js front-end proxies every API call server-side and keeps the auth token in an httpOnly cookie.

title: Facial-Recognition Access Control
tagline: Hikvision access control for 570+ daily users.
description: Maintenance and improvement of a Hikvision facial-recognition access-control system (Next.js + Laravel) at Megasec, plus a second isolated deployment for another company.
longDescription: At Megasec I maintain and improve a Hikvision facial-recognition access-control system built on Next.js and Laravel, used by 420+ people daily. I also deployed a second instance on another company's isolated server, locked to their own devices, serving 150+ daily users.

title: Risk Registry Systems
tagline: Enterprise risk management for several organizations.
description: Enterprise risk-registry systems built at Megasec for several organizations: risk scoring, treatment plans, incidents, audit trails and reporting.
longDescription: At Megasec I build risk-registry (enterprise risk management) systems, each tailored to the organization using it: risk assessment and scoring, treatment plans, incident and task tracking, department-level role-based access, audit trails, two-factor authentication, evidence uploads and reporting dashboards. They run inside each organization's network, so there is no public demo.

title: Business Management Systems
tagline: Internal ops & automation on the Google Apps Script API.
description: Internal management, workflow automation, and operational systems for investment, IT, education and hospitality businesses, integrating Google Apps Script APIs to streamline admin work.
longDescription: A set of internal tools for education and hospitality businesses, built in Next.js on top of the Google Apps Script API. Turns spreadsheet-driven processes into real interfaces – workflow automation, operational dashboards, and the day-to-day surfaces staff actually run on.

title: CPM Invest Brokerage Platform
tagline: Backend for an investment brokerage platform.
description: Core backend of CPM Invest's investment brokerage platform: KYC, securities orders, balances, commissions and approval workflows.
longDescription: I'm the core backend developer of CPM Invest's investment brokerage platform – Node.js and Express over MongoDB. It covers customer KYC and document signing, buy / sell / repo orders on securities, balances in AZN, USD and EUR, commissions and tariffs, and multi-level approval workflows – integrated with the central securities depository over ISO 20022, the 1C accounting system, SIMA national digital signatures, Firebase push notifications and Socket.IO real-time events.

title: EcoTrail
description: A trail explorer for Azerbaijan – trails and places on a map, local guides and their tours, and reviews – on web and mobile.
longDescription: EcoTrail maps Azerbaijan's hiking trails and the places along them, organised by district and economic region. Local guides can apply, get approved and publish tours, and hikers leave reviews. It's a three-repo project: a Laravel 13 API with Sanctum on PostgreSQL, a Next.js 16 web app with MapLibre maps, and an Expo / React Native mobile app – all open source.

title: Capital Construction
description: Corporate landing page focused on responsive UI and SEO optimization.
longDescription: A corporate landing page in Next.js for a construction firm – responsive UI, clean structure, and SEO optimization. The kind of site whose whole job is to load fast, read clearly, and convert.

title: NOVARC Media
tagline: Futuristic, scroll-driven site for a media company.
description: Futuristic frontend with interactive scrolling for a media company.
longDescription: A media-company site built in Next.js, leaning on interactive scrolling and motion to carry the brand. Front-end focused: animation, layout, and the kind of scroll choreography that has to feel weightless.

title: Citrus Valley
description: Marketing website delivered for Citrus Valley.
longDescription: A marketing website delivered for Citrus Valley as freelance work – front-end focused, responsive, and built to load fast.

title: Grinduck
longDescription: A marketing website delivered for Grinduck as freelance work – front-end focused, responsive, and built to load fast.

title: Remind Notification
tagline: Landing page for a reminder product.
description: Landing page for a reminder / notification product, built in Astro.
longDescription: A lean, static landing page for a reminder and notification product – built in Astro for instant loads and easy upkeep. Front-end focused: clean layout, quick delivery, no moving parts to maintain.
